faqs.q: How long does a water heater installation take?
faqs.a: A standard tank-to-tank replacement typically takes 2 to 3 hours. If we need to upgrade the gas line, modify venting, or switch fuel types, the project may take 4 to 6 hours.

faqs.q: What size water heater does my family need?
faqs.a: For a household of 2 to 3 people, a 40-gallon tank is typically sufficient. Families of 4 to 5 should consider 50 gallons, and larger households may need 65 to 80 gallons or a tankless system.

faqs.q: Do I need an expansion tank?
faqs.a: Yes - North Carolina plumbing code requires a thermal expansion tank on any closed plumbing system. We include expansion tank installation as a standard part of every water heater replacement.
